title: VR Feedback Bridge
description: Read player feedback from VR desktop overlay. Comments are written to ada_run/ during gameplay.

nodes.label: Read ada_run/desktop_feedback.md
nodes.detail: Timestamped entries with map, sequence, artifact context + user comment.

nodes.label: Parse feedback entries
nodes.detail: Each entry has: timestamp, map name, sequence, artifact list, comment text.

nodes.label: What kind of feedback?
nodes.detail: Bug report, feature request, visual issue, or general comment.

nodes.label: Create task or fix directly
nodes.detail: Bug: fix now. Feature: add to backlog. Visual: load artifact-visual-upgrade flow.
